Title: Green Lantern Vol 5 13

URL Source: https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Lantern_Vol_5_13

Markdown Content:
****_Green Lantern_ (Volume 5) #13**** is an issue of the series [_Green Lantern_ (Volume 5)](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Lantern_Vol_5 "Green Lantern Vol 5") with a cover date of [December, 2012](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Category:2012,_December "Category:2012, December"). It was published on October 3, 2012.

## Synopsis for "Actions and Reactions"

At the [White House](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/White_House "White House"), [Amanda Waller](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Amanda_Waller_(Prime_Earth) "Amanda Waller (Prime Earth)") briefs [President Obama](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Barack_Obama_(Prime_Earth) "Barack Obama (Prime Earth)") about the [Green Lanterns](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Lantern_Corps "Green Lantern Corps") of [Earth](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Earth "Earth"). She also says that a fifth Lantern, [Simon Baz](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Simon_Baz_(Prime_Earth) "Simon Baz (Prime Earth)"), has been chosen. Waller is wondering why did a Green Lantern chose someone as Simon as its wielder, as Simon is a presumed terrorist. The President tells Waller to inform the [Justice League](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Justice_League_(Prime_Earth) "Justice League (Prime Earth)").

Simon awakens alone in the Florida Keys. His [ring](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Lantern_Power_Ring "Green Lantern Power Ring") suddenly plays out a message from [Hal Jordan](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Green_Lantern_(Hal_Jordan) "Green Lantern (Hal Jordan)") and [Sinestro](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Thaal_Sinestro_(Prime_Earth) "Thaal Sinestro (Prime Earth)"). The message is corrupted, but Hal and Sinestro tell the current wielder to find [Carol Ferris](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Carol_Ferris_(Prime_Earth) "Carol Ferris (Prime Earth)") and [Arkillo](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Arkillo_(Prime_Earth) "Arkillo (Prime Earth)"). Also, they says that whoever is wielding the ring must stop the [Guardians](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Guardians_of_the_Universe "Guardians of the Universe"). The ring grants Simon a Green Lantern uniform, unlocking the ability to fly.

Meanwhile, on a highway, a truck is attacked by [Third Army](https://dc.fandom.com/wiki/Third_Army "Third Army") soldiers, who assimilate the driver and the passenger into soldiers. The Third Army soldiers receive information that a Green Lantern ring has been detected on Earth. They are given instructions to locate the ring and assimilate the bearer into the Third Army.

At night, Simon goes to his old school and climbs to the rooftop. To prevent security cameras from watching him, he uses the ring to create a mask. An unexpected blow knocks him from the roof to the street below, where he lands on a parked car, severely damaging it. He hears a voice telling him that he is in a lot of trouble. Looking up, he sees the entire Justice League arrayed against him.
